name: Foundations in Data Engineering
description: Data organization, efficient analysis of large data sets, distributed data storage (depending on system architecture, e.g. multi-core systems, multi-processor systems, clusters), distributed and parallel data analysis, statistics-backed optimization of analytical processes (z.B. by dimensionality reduction), map/reduce techniques and their generalization for distributed query processing, applications in systems as Hadoop and NoSQL systems, effects on society, importance of privacy protection
prerequisites: IN0001 Introduction to Informatics 1, IN0008 Fundamentals of Databases, IN0007 Fundamentals of Algorithms and Data Structures
